This file carries the license notice for addon-fit.js, the vendored
@xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0 UMD bundle (see the provenance comment on
VENDOR_FIT_JS in ../../src/lib.rs). Its source map names only the add-on's
own FitAddon.ts plus webpack's bootstrap, so the single MIT text below is
the whole of what its distribution requires. Copied verbatim from the
package's own LICENSE file as published to npm.

Certification digests:
- registry tarball @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0:
  sha256:26003b4517a132b64e4ff228fd88a5fda3fff5e606c76093f6dcff772e9ecec0
- retained addon-fit.js, byte-identical to the tarball's lib/addon-fit.js:
  sha256:ba3ea256ce0620a0992a197d6c9baea64823fc93d8da07a9e366ca9943c18527

This notice ships inside the distributed bundles, not just beside the
source: FIT_LICENSES in ../../src/lib.rs declares this file as an asset.
